answer: Farming becomes a pulse bet on surviving 55 epochs of grading, and every ivory settlement recomputes the onyx schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 55 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 22 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
